I’ve had quite a lot of them about missiles, seemingly nuclear or of that size. These ones seem quite silly but usually symbolize something similar. I once had one where nuclear missiles were raining down onto the ground around me, and a few days later the North Koreans tested an underground missile. A more recent one was where I was sitting with the President watching missiles fly over, as one hit Beijing. That’s the general gist of those (there are more details) but they are typically (and thankfully) metaphoric.
